summary: Summit Hotel Properties filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $200 million of common stock, with sales agents including Baird, BofA, J.P. Morgan, and Wells Fargo. The program permits forward sale agreements, under which the company may not receive proceeds until physical settlement. Shares trade on NYSE at $6.89 (Aug 4, 2026). This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation; no price, premium, or strategic event is stated. Watch for dilution and forward-settlement mechanics but no risk-arb angle.
